purpose: Establish recursive RT composition, domain-relative primitivity, recursive aspect discovery, orientation-field interpretation, and MTO/OTM recursion as the structural procedural mechanism of RT.

primitive_cycle: RT becomes primitive in the next compositional domain.
closure_statement: RT is assumed closed within a domain when no further lawful aspects are discoverable.

absolute_primitive.definition: Absolute primitive condition for distinction to be realized.

composition_operator.definition: Primitive relational composition operator producing RT closure.

RT.recursive_definition: A pattern may itself be recursively composed of closed RT patterns from lower domains.
RT.closure_definition: Closure of all lawful aspects discoverable within the active compositional domain.

axioms.statement: Pattern may recursively contain closed patterns.
A collection of patterns organized relationally constitutes a higher-order pattern.
One pattern and many patterns are not contradictory; they describe different recursive domains.

domain_lift.principle: Closure in one domain becomes primitive in the next.
notes: Composite objects in one domain become atomic primitives in the next.

MTO_OTM.termination: Within a domain, recursion terminates when no further lawful aspects are discoverable.

evaluation_model.name: Domain Precedence Evaluation
evaluation_model.motivation: Replace arithmetic precedence with recursive compositional precedence.
rules: Each child RT reaches closure before parent evaluation.
Parent RT composes only closed child RTs.

example.note: Arithmetic is illustrative only. Final implementation will use relation indices rather than numeric values.

relation_indices.purpose: Replace arithmetic primitives with indexed relational primitives.
motivation: Actual implementation preserves relational identity through indexed provenance.

principles: Only condition changes under changing orientation.
Orientation is conditioned by distinction density.

field.capacity: Extremely large but finite orientation space.
field.realization: Current RT is a realized orientation pattern.

condition_theory.fundamental_statement: Nothing moves. Boundary interactions condition distinction density. Distinction density conditions orientation. Orientation conditions realized condition.

principles: Entities interact only through causal boundaries.
Boundary interaction reconditions internal distinction density.
Identity is preserved unless density pattern itself changes.

identity_and_type.note: Relationship between density-pattern identity and higher-order closure remains open for further formalization.

interpretation: Finite but practically inexhaustible orientation capacity.
Complete RT is not a single cell.
Complete RT is the recursively organized orientation pattern.

principles: A single pattern is an RT within its domain.
A recursively organized collection of RT patterns is a higher-order RT.
Like a GIF, completeness is achieved through recursive relational organization, not physical motion.

open_obligations.title: Formal definition of lawful aspect discovery.
Formal recursive stopping criterion for domain closure.
Formal proof obligations for MTO/OTM recursion.
Formal distinction between identity, type, condition, and recursive pattern.
Formal evaluation semantics using domain precedence.

instructions: Do not reinterpret using conventional arithmetic semantics.
Preserve provenance across all recursive decompositions.
Treat numeric examples as illustrative scaffolding only unless explicitly promoted.
